entry.title: Universal opt-in replay protection?
entry.summary: The discussion revolves around the implementation strategies in a prototype, highlighting considerations against introducing new key types or encodings. The emphasis is on ensuring that any future key types should incorporate replay protection inherently. Moreover, the approach under consideration appears to have limitations regarding its compatibility with key-path spends. This indicates a need for a solution that accommodates flexibility while enhancing security measures in cryptographic key management.
